events.body:
## Context

`workers/main.py:11` lists `https://next.owaspbt.org` (missing the "l"), so CORS headers are never sent for the real site. `wrangler.toml` defines `ALLOWED_ORIGIN`, which main.py never reads, and README documents a third name. The local dev origin `localhost:8787` isn't allowed either.

## What to do

1. Fix the spelling and add `http://localhost:8787`.
2. Either read origins from the env var (comma-separated) or delete it; make README use the same name.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Origin: https://next.owaspblt.org` gets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`
- [ ] README and wrangler.toml agree

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-next && npx wrangler dev
curl -i -H 'Origin: https://next.owaspblt.org' localhost:8787/api/stats
```

---
